decision.rationale: The dispute is within the time limit. TXN-007928 posted on 2026-09-02 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-22, which is 50 days later. The limit is 120 days. Larkspur Brasserie (MER-000038) is a RESTAURANT merchant. The posting is 8850 cents, and its authorisation AUTH-008134 (contactless, approved) was for 7437 cents. No receipt is attached to the case. The 74.37 EUR figure comes only from the cardholder's statement, so it is a claim, not a receipt. The posting is 8850 - 7437 = 1413 cents above the authorisation. The tolerance is 20% of the authorised amount, which is 1487.4 cents. The difference is within that tolerance, so under amount-restaurant-tip it counts as an agreed tip, not a mismatch, and the dispute is declined.

proposed_actions.reason: Your card was authorised for 74.37 EUR at Larkspur Brasserie, and the final charge was 88.50 EUR. A restaurant may add a tip of up to 20% of the authorised amount, which here is 14.87 EUR. The 14.13 EUR difference is within that limit, so it is treated as an agreed tip rather than an incorrect amount.
